notes: Paths are relative to the repository root. Design citations name the November document, its section and a short quote. 'release_gate': true marks a gap that must close before any production mobile release even though it does not block WO-002 development. Optional fields: 'release_gate', 'severity' (security gaps) and 'wo002_condition' (API-1).

gaps.november_requirement: FIN-01 v3.3 S128 'FIN-INV-07 No Seller manual payment confirmation'; ORDER-01 v3.3 S135 'ORDER-INV-05: Seller never confirms Buyer payment manually.'
gaps.current_behavior: core.fn_confirm_payment (0021:26-68) sets PAYMENT_CONFIRMED and mints the handoff QR; fn_reject_payment (0021:77, 0042:98) returns the order to NOTIFIED. The legal-transition table has one entry into PAYMENT_CONFIRMED: 'seller confirms' (0011:272). Routes POST /v1/seller/orders/{id}/payment/confirm|reject (orders.controller.ts:207,220) gated by seller.payment:confirm, seeded MOBILE+CONSOLE for OWNER/ADMIN/SALES_SUPPORT (0006:112,169-171). Console PaymentDecisions.tsx; stats trigger 0012:565-586.
gaps.future_correction: Retire both routes, both functions, the permission and its grants. PAID is set only by the provider-verified Finance-to-Order transaction (WO-PAY-001). Add read-only seller.payments:read.
gaps.migration_risk: HIGH - the only path into the paid state; QR mint, handoff, stats and obligations hang off it.

gaps.november_requirement: FIN-01 v3.3 S129 'removes the previous direct bank-transfer instruction system ... manual receiving-account snapshot/reissue workflow'.
gaps.current_behavior: core.order_payout_snapshot (0012:181), financial.render_payment_instructions (0012:286), fn_reissue_instructions (0022:186-227), step-up action REISSUE_INSTRUCTIONS (0001:172-175). GET /v1/orders/{id}/payment-instructions decrypts the seller account number (financial.service.ts:48-68); POST /v1/seller/orders/{id}/reissue-instructions.
gaps.future_correction: Drop the snapshot, render and reissue machinery and both routes; Buyer gets payment-attempt and payment-status routes (FIN-01 S70).
gaps.migration_risk: MEDIUM - self-contained, but fn_create_order writes the snapshot (PAY-4).

gaps.november_requirement: ORDER-01 v3.3 S49 'There is no Seller action to confirm receipt of payment and no Buyer payment-screenshot path.'
gaps.current_behavior: financial.payment_evidence (0012:45), core.payment_submission (0012:115), POST /v1/orders/{id}/payment-evidence and GET /v1/seller/orders/{id}/payment-evidence (financial.controller.ts:41,57). commitEvidence moves the order with a raw UPDATE core.order SET state='PAYMENT_SUBMITTED' from the API (financial.service.ts:141), not through a named command (ORDER-01 S60).
gaps.future_correction: Remove upload and view paths and payment_submission; keep the framed-encryption and logged-read pattern for provider evidence (FIN-01 S43-45).
gaps.migration_risk: MEDIUM - Claims attach this evidence (PAY-11); existing rows need a retention decision.

gaps.november_requirement: FIN-01 v3.3 S32 'Do not collect or store full Seller bank credentials merely because the legacy system once did.'
gaps.current_behavior: core.payout_details (0012:135) and financial.payout_credential (0012:66) hold the full account; readiness gate PAYOUT_DETAILS (0018:355-359); fn_create_order refuses without an active payout (0028:256-260); /v1/seller/payout*; job payout.activate_due.
gaps.future_correction: SellerProviderAccount (FIN-01 S33): provider reference plus masked destination; readiness gate becomes provider onboarding; order creation stops needing a payout snapshot; reuse the step-up/delay/audit pattern.
gaps.migration_risk: HIGH - order creation and seller readiness depend on it; existing ciphertext needs a purge plan.

gaps.november_requirement: ORDER-01 v3.3 S57 'Payment state is independent from operational Order readiness.'; S58 fulfilment dimension (PREPARING ... DELIVERED); S59 derived Order state.
gaps.current_behavior: One enum core.order_state (0001:208-211): CREATED, NOTIFIED, PAYMENT_SUBMITTED, PAYMENT_CONFIRMED, HANDED_OFF, COMPLETED, CANCELLED_BY_BUYER, CANCELLED_BY_SELLER, EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED; 17 legal transitions (0011:267-283); reservation_state with 6. It mixes payment, fulfilment and cancellation; no PREPARING, CHARGE_VERIFIED_ORDER_PROCESSING, PAID_BUT_UNFULFILLABLE or RECONCILING.
affected_files: orders, handoff, claims, deletion and obligations services
gaps.future_correction: Separate payment, fulfilment, allocation and cancellation dimensions; re-seed the legal tables; one projection returns the derived state and allowed_actions. Replace the enum, do not extend it.
gaps.migration_risk: HIGH - the most-referenced state in the codebase (23 migrations, 11 API files).

gaps.november_requirement: ORDER-01 v3.3 S51 'Local deadline schedules reconciliation/cancellation enquiry, not a declaration of unpaid finality.'; KB v3.3 S55 supersedes the old pre-payment timer model.
gaps.current_behavior: fn_create_order takes stock and sets expires_at = now() + reservation_window ('48h', 0002:287); order.expire_sweep releases on the timer alone (e1-clock.ts:37-92); morning payment reminder (e2-notification.ts:274-297).
gaps.future_correction: Checkout allocation bound to one payment attempt, released only by the ORDER-01 S35/S46 predicate. The checkout-attempt window duration was not found in ORDER-01 or FIN-01: confirm it with the founder before WO-PAY-001.

gaps.november_requirement: MOB-02 v4.3 S146 'Seller does not accept the purchase and does not confirm money receipt.'
gaps.current_behavior: Obligation kind payment_awaiting_confirmation (obligations.controller.ts:68,101-137); fn_confirmation_window_lapse opens an SLA_BREACH claim (0014:278-316); job order.close_confirmation_window; storefront publishes confirmation_rate and missed_confirmation_windows (storefront.controller.ts:109-111).
gaps.future_correction: Replace with paid-order prepare/mark-ready obligations and a PAYMENT_STATUS_EXCEPTION trigger (CLAIM-01 S13); drop the two public payment stats.

gaps.november_requirement: ORDER-01 v3.3 S135 'ORDER-INV-16: Refund completion is provider/Finance verified, not Seller-reported.'
gaps.current_behavior: core.refund (0011:529-536), fn_report_refund and fn_acknowledge_refund (0021:308-352); POST /v1/seller/orders/{id}/refunds and POST /v1/orders/{id}/refunds/{rid}/acknowledge.
gaps.future_correction: RefundRequest (FIN-01 S52) with provider reconciliation.

gaps.november_requirement: FIN-01 v3.3 S17-18 PaymentAttempt, ExternalCharge 'UNIQUE(provider, environment, merchant_ref, provider_transaction_id)', PaymentProviderEvent; S70-73 routes.
gaps.current_behavior: Absent: no surcharge, chapa, webhook, escrow or payment-attempt anywhere in db/migrations, apps/api or contracts/openapi.json; no commercial snapshot.
gaps.future_correction: FIN-01 S130 phases 0-4 behind a provider-neutral adapter; also MISSING_SCHEMA for the tables.

gaps.november_requirement: FIN-01 v3.3 S45 'one ambiguous shared actor ID for ordinary and Operator identities is forbidden.'; S50 'Do not claim deletion if object removal failed.'
gaps.current_behavior: financial.purge_payment_evidence (0026:200-224) and the hourly job select only rows with validated_at IS NOT NULL, and nothing writes validated_at (only 0012:53 declares it), so screenshots are never purged. financial.access_log has one actor_account_id (0012:87-96).

gaps.november_requirement: CLAIM-01 v3.2 S27 'Screenshots or Seller statements may be party evidence, never paid authority'; S15 AWAITING_PROVIDER_RECONCILIATION.
gaps.current_behavior: Claim enums carry PAYMENT_EVIDENCE, BANK_RECORD, AWAITING_BANK_TRACE, PAYMENT_FRAUD (0001:226-247); fn_claim_attach_evidence retains screenshots (0014:185-190); the only SYSTEM SLA_BREACH source is the confirmation lapse (0014:308), while the console labels it as a handoff miss (en.console.ts:623).

gaps.november_requirement: HND-01 v3.2 S5 'Handoff begins only after operational Order PAID and stock are jointly committed'.

gaps.future_correction: Mint handoff credentials at the joint PAID and stock commit; remove the expired-to-handed-off transition (reachability inferred, not tested).

gaps.november_requirement: MOB-02 v4.3 S31 'Multi-cart preserves seller-specific Orders'; S1 'seller-specific Cart/Checkout/Orders'.
gaps.current_behavior: One cart per buyer and one seller per cart: POST /v1/cart/lines returns '409 CART_SELLER_CONFLICT on a second seller' (contracts/openapi.json summary).
gaps.future_correction: Multi-cart with one Seller Order per seller under one coordinated checkout, in WO-PAY-001.

gaps.november_requirement: FIN-01 v3.3 S28 'No internal Seller balance for purchase proceeds is introduced by this design.'

gaps.future_correction: Keep; settlement facts go in their own table.

gaps.november_requirement: FIN-01 v3.3 S22 'surcharge_rate_bps = 0 and surcharge_minor = 0'.

gaps.future_correction: Add the FIN-01 S23 snapshot columns when checkout is built.

gaps.november_requirement: R-09 'Products show the catalogue with available first'; R-06 current price plus 'Currently unavailable'.
gaps.current_behavior: fn_unpublish_product sets only visibility='UNPUBLISHED' (0020:33-36), but the storefront list, detail, search and link-resolve queries filter on published_at IS NOT NULL (storefront.controller.ts:141,168,216,296), so unpublished Products stay public. They also read base_price_minor, which 0007:139-141 documents as a seed value no storefront render reads. No availability field or ordering.

gaps.november_requirement: R-09 'share Scenes / Products / Reviews / About and open on Scenes'.

gaps.future_correction: Extend the header DTO; add a Scenes read for the storefront.

gaps.november_requirement: REV-01 v3.3 S16 'No unverified fallback.'; S28 review-eligibility and Product reviews reads; R-08 'edit updates instead of duplicating'.
gaps.current_behavior: Cancelled and expired orders can be reviewed and unverified reviews publish with badge UNVERIFIED (reviews.controller.ts:35,71; 0014:69-71); no eligibility read, edit, own-review read or public Product reviews; no VERIFIED_ORDER_FAILURE basis (0001:222-224); item ratings take a client product_id. Two separate ratings: aligned.

gaps.november_requirement: TRUST-01 v3.3 S9 levels NEW, REBUILDING, ESTABLISHED, TRUSTED; S11 'Trust never limits Product or item listing count'; S58 timely remedy does not auto-drop the level.

gaps.migration_risk: HIGH - enum, publication limits and level history.

gaps.november_requirement: TRUST-01 v3.3 S7 'Social audience size, external popularity ... are not Trust evidence.'
gaps.current_behavior: seller_public_stats holds level and reliability only (0010:155-175); follower count only in private analytics.
gaps.future_correction: Keep Like and follower counts out of public stats.

gaps.november_requirement: NOTIF-01 v3.3 S40 'context_kind # BUYER | SELLER | COURIER | OPERATOR'; S45 'Ordinary preferences belong to the stable Account'; S130 /v1/notification-preferences.

gaps.future_correction: context_kind, Account-level preferences, typed deep links, correct optional parameters.

gaps.current_behavior: No projection; order lines return variant_id, product_name and variant_key but no product id or slug (orders.service.ts:270-274), so the client cannot open the Product. listOrders maps line_count from a column it never selects (orders.service.ts:223-224,239).
gaps.future_correction: Purchased-products read, or a Product reference on order lines; fix line_count.

gaps.november_requirement: R-11 'Edit Profile, saved discovery area, Appearance, notification preferences, Privacy & Security, Help & Support, Delete Account and Sign Out.'
gaps.current_behavior: Sessions, revoke and deletion preview/confirm exist; no buyer profile data (0003:84-88), no profile route, no discovery area, no buyer preferences; Appearance is client-only.
gaps.future_correction: Profile fields and routes, discovery area, buyer preferences.

gaps.november_requirement: R-01 'Buyer-facing copy uses Product and Scene'.
gaps.current_behavior: API and DB say product (consistent); 'post' means an external social link in the build; the mobile catalogue (100 keys) has no Home, tab, Product or Scene vocabulary; the foundation hardcodes English labels (apps/mobile/src/modes/ModeShell.tsx:30,34).
gaps.future_correction: A separate packages/locale PR with Buyer navigation and channel keys in both languages before or alongside WO-002.

gaps.november_requirement: MOB-02 v4.3 S11 'Buyer bottom navigation: Home | Shop | Saved | Orders | You.'; S13 route tree for the five Home channels.
gaps.current_behavior: Specified in the design and identical in the prototype (MobileBuyer.tsx:112-117); bootstrap supplies market, locales and flags.
gaps.future_correction: None; this is WO-002's input.

gaps.november_requirement: ARCH-PLATFORM-01 v3.3 S23 'BullMQ is the sole ordinary execution technology. No Graphile Worker, Kafka, RabbitMQ or Temporal'.
gaps.current_behavior: graphile-worker ^0.17.3 (apps/api/package.json:28) runs 22 cron tasks (runtime.ts); STACK_BASELINE and root CLAUDE.md reject Redis; ADU-CON-02 S3.6 and ADU-DB-01 S24 specify graphile.

gaps.november_requirement: ARCH-PLATFORM-01 v3.3 S39 'Valkey / BullMQ unavailable | PostgreSQL truth and required outbox/job intent remain'.
gaps.current_behavior: Intent is written to domain tables in the business transaction (core.notification QUEUED rows, order.expires_at); nothing calls graphile add_job outside a test; jobs poll.
gaps.future_correction: None for durability: PostgreSQL holds intent in both models.

gaps.november_requirement: ARCH-PLATFORM-01 v3.3 S23 'Business changes and required event_outbox and/or job_intent commit in the same PostgreSQL transaction.'; EVT-01 v3.2 S10, S14.
gaps.current_behavior: No event_outbox, event_delivery, job_intent, relay or dead-letter table; each domain has its own queue table.
gaps.future_correction: Needed whichever engine wins if the November eventing model is adopted; after WRK-1.

gaps.november_requirement: EVT-01 v3.2 S27 'Per-entity deadlines use delayed jobs; recurring jobs scan due canonical rows in bounded pages.'
gaps.current_behavior: Bounded recurring scans only (LIMIT 500, one-minute granularity); no delayed per-entity jobs.
gaps.future_correction: Delayed jobs only if BullMQ is adopted; sweeps stay as repair.

gaps.november_requirement: ARCH-PLATFORM-01 v3.3 S23 'Delivery is at-least-once; workers re-read current canonical scope/state'.
gaps.current_behavior: Every job idempotent (DB-01 S24); compare-and-set and SKIP LOCKED claims; state re-read at send time.
gaps.future_correction: None.

gaps.november_requirement: ARCH-PLATFORM-01 v3.3 S38 'Retries have bounded backoff/jitter, classified transient/permanent outcomes'.
gaps.current_behavior: Graphile retries the whole cron task; a per-row failure is terminal (e2-notification.ts:142-145), including RETRYABLE push outcomes (e2:236-238); no dead-letter store.
gaps.future_correction: Classified per-row retry with next_attempt_at (NOTIF-01 S41) and dead letters; engine-independent.

gaps.november_requirement: OBS-01 v3.2 S24 'event_outbox and job_intent pending age | Per class oldest age/count'.
gaps.current_behavior: Heartbeat row read by /healthz; per-job logs; no queue-age or backlog metrics.
gaps.future_correction: Oldest-QUEUED-age metrics on the domain queue tables now; queue metrics if the engine changes.

gaps.november_requirement: ARCH-PLATFORM-01 v3.3 S32 'Shared rate coordination may use Valkey'; AUTH-02 v3.3 S134 may degrade to database-backed behaviour, never fail open.
gaps.current_behavior: PostgreSQL fixed-window buckets (rate-limit.service.ts:55-65; core.rate_limit_bucket).
gaps.future_correction: None required: Valkey is optional and the PostgreSQL limiter is the design's own fail-closed fallback.

gaps.november_requirement: ARCH-PLATFORM-01 v3.3 S32 'Valkey caches only rebuildable non-authoritative data'.
gaps.current_behavior: No server cache exists.
gaps.future_correction: None until measured.

gaps.november_requirement: DEPLOY-01 v3.2 S50 separate managed instances for BullMQ/coordination and for disposable cache; S51 'Queue Valkey uses noeviction'.
gaps.current_behavior: ops/render.yaml: one PostgreSQL, api, worker, console, no Key Value service; never applied (render.yaml:4).

gaps.november_requirement: AUTH-02 v3.3 S31 'The client holds an opaque credential; PostgreSQL stores the hash and canonical session state.'
gaps.current_behavior: core.session.id is the credential (authenticate() looks up WHERE s.id = token, session.service.ts; minting returns token: sessionId, auth.service.ts:343) and is stored in plain form. GET /v1/auth/sessions returns s.id (and device_id) for every live session of the account (auth.service.ts:373-390), so any session can read the bearer tokens and cookie values of the account's other sessions, including a MOBILE session obtaining a CONSOLE session id. This defeats the httpOnly cookie and the MOBILE/CONSOLE surface boundary within one account.
gaps.future_correction: token_hash column plus a separate public session id; look up by hash; /sessions and DELETE use the public id; reissue all sessions (global sign-out). First item of WO-API-001.
gaps.migration_risk: HIGH - forces a global sign-out; console revoke-by-id changes.
gaps.confidence: verified (code and the c6 test that equates the listed id with the cookie)
gaps.severity: HIGH - one compromised session or one console XSS yields every live credential on the account, persistently; a replayed listed CONSOLE id works from any HTTP client and counts as a known device for the new-device payout lock (financial.service.ts:346). Bounded by: same account only; SMS step-up still guards payout, ownership and revoke-all.

resolution.evidence: Migration 0053 adds core.session.token_hash (SHA-256 of a 32-byte random credential); SessionService authenticates by hash; core.session.id is a public id and no longer authenticates; GET /v1/auth/sessions lists public ids only and no device_id; one-time global sign-out. Tests: apps/api/test/wo-api-001a-auth-security.e2e.spec.ts (SEC-1, migration 0053).

gaps.november_requirement: AUTH-02 v3.3 S31 (device and session state are canonical server state); NOTIF-01 v3.3 S62 push token belongs to the registered device.
gaps.current_behavior: PATCH /v1/devices/:id is @Public (auth.controller.ts:369-378) and updates push_token and notification_permission WHERE id = :id with no ownership check (auth.service.ts:560-580); device ids are also listed by GET /v1/auth/sessions (SEC-1). Anyone holding a device id can redirect that device's push notifications.
gaps.future_correction: Bind the update to a device credential or to the authenticated session's device.
gaps.severity: MEDIUM (LOW until a push provider is bound: NullPushAdapter today) - unauthenticated write to another account's device push token and permission; device ids are client-chosen, sent in X-Adulis-Device on every request and listed by GET /v1/auth/sessions.

resolution.evidence: PATCH /v1/devices/{id} is authenticated and bound to the calling session device on the caller's account; other ids answer 404 alike. Tests: apps/api/test/wo-api-001a-auth-security.e2e.spec.ts (SEC-2), c6.

gaps.november_requirement: AUTH-02 v3.3 S31 'The client holds an opaque credential; PostgreSQL stores the hash and canonical session state.'
gaps.current_behavior: otp/verify records session_token and the raw device_cookie_token in core.idempotency_record.response_body for the replay window (auth.controller.ts:237-248) and re-serves them on an identical replay (auth.controller.ts:224-227). The remembered-device secret is otherwise stored only as a sha256 hash (auth.service.ts:296-313), which this undoes. Live session ids also sit in core.payout_change_log.session_id and revoked_by_session_id columns.
gaps.future_correction: Replay returns a non-secret marker (or re-mints) instead of storing raw tokens; with SEC-1, session ids stop being credentials so the log columns become harmless. Fix together with SEC-1.
gaps.severity: MEDIUM - plaintext credentials at rest for 24h in a general-purpose table.
gaps.confidence: verified (code reading; found by the WO-001C security review)

resolution.evidence: OTP verify stores only {credential_withheld, session_id}; an identical replay answers OTP_EXPIRED with no credential; 0053 deletes pre-existing verify records. Tests: apps/api/test/wo-api-001a-auth-security.e2e.spec.ts (SEC-3, migration 0053).

gaps.november_requirement: AUTH-02 v3.3 step-up catalogue: revoking all other sessions is a step-up action, CONSOLE only.
gaps.current_behavior: POST /v1/auth/sessions/revoke-others requires CONSOLE and step-up (auth.service.ts:443-466), but DELETE /v1/auth/sessions/{id} (revokeSession, auth.service.ts:421-436) checks only account ownership, no audience and no step-up. Any session, MOBILE included, can list the account's sessions (SEC-1) and delete each one: revoke-all without step-up, e.g. signing the owner out of the console everywhere from a stolen phone.
gaps.future_correction: Decide the rule for single-session revoke from MOBILE (own session only, or same audience only); keep cross-session revoke behind the step-up path. Fix with SEC-1 in WO-API-001 slice A.
gaps.severity: LOW to MEDIUM - availability and account-control impact, no data disclosure.
gaps.confidence: verified (code reading; found by the WO-001C security review)

resolution.evidence: POST /v1/auth/logout and DELETE on the own id revoke the calling session without step-up; another session is CONSOLE-only with a consumed REVOKE_ALL_SESSIONS step-up (target-bound when named); MOBILE gets 403; revoke-others refuses a target-bound proof. Tests: apps/api/test/wo-api-001a-auth-security.e2e.spec.ts (SEC-4), c6.
